title: Monsoon Street, After Hours
summary: A one-point-perspective shopping street rebuilt after a photo: A the tram crosses the vanishing point in a downpour, B at 2 a.m. the puddle mirrors the street.
request: rebuild Pexels 18867525 (a one-point-perspective shopping street after rain) as a dim blue-hour / night street in its own camera, cosy-lightmap `--scene exterior`, 480x270 at 4x. Two stills of the best moments (A "Downpour: the tram crosses", B "2 a.m.: the mirror") and a 5 s lofi sample of the downpour phase.

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: (pixelate audio music sound/full.wav || [ $? -eq 2 ]) && python3 sound/make_sample.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/01-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/01-sample.mp3
